Callout.Name: Fall from Height
Callout.Message: Tradesman fallen from a ladder, conscious.
Callout.Advisory: Casualty on the ground, colleague applying pressure.

Script.Line: Third rung. It was not even the top of the ladder.
I had a box of tiles in one hand. That is why I went.
It is my back. Everything else is fine, it is my back.

Callout.Patient: I landed on my side. I can move my fingers. That is something.

Lines.Approach: They went off the third rung carrying something. Their mate is holding pressure.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
